findings.trigger: A composed current tree changes only one of the two reviewed PR-003 inputs: package.json or tests/contract-package-inventory.test.mjs. The other path retains its historical bytes.
findings.observed: validateHistoricalCiProof returns a passing input_bindings result and records one reviewed_current_transition for either partial map. The d182 tests cover only the both-input positive map and do not reject either partial map.
findings.impact: The PR-003 transition is not bound as a complete pair. In the final composed root, buildCurrentDraft/buildCiIntegrationReceipt checks the package's root sequence but does not validate the inventory-test source, so a mismatched package/test pair can produce a PASS pending CI draft even though the ordinary test:worker stage would fail. This weakens the required exact dual-chain/input binding and can let the historical proof layer accept an incomplete transition.
findings.minimal_fix: After the pin loop, if any reviewed PR-003 transition is observed, require the unique transitioned paths to equal both REVIEWED_PR003_CURRENT_INPUTS paths (while preserving the valid zero-transition original chain). Add package-only and inventory-test-only negative controls to tests/ci-attestation.test.mjs.
